verdict.rationale: mParticle's own documentation says it can forward customer data to downstream services, including data warehousing destinations (docs-11, docs-25). That is a first-party way to get data out, but the evidence covers only one-line mentions of ongoing forwarding, not a bulk export for leaving. Warehouse Sync (docs-x4) is ingest-only, so it does not count toward export. Missing for 10: documented full-data export (events, profiles, identities, audiences), open-format specification (e.g., Parquet/CSV/JSON), explicit exit or offboarding path, independent or hands-on corroboration.
